_comment: The macro-annotated twin is the parchment master with region contours and province counts drawn on top; it is the SAME FILE underneath (identical 3703x2880 dims, grayscale correlation 0.803, median absolute difference 3 over the unannotated area). The alias is therefore the identity, and any future correction to the master's control points reaches this record for free.

record.notes: Annotated twin of the IE parchment master: each macro region outlined in a saturated hue and labelled with its Immortal Empires province count. Consumed by worldgen/macro.py, which recovers the contours by DIFFERENCING this against the clean master rather than by thresholding it - a difference cancels the coats of arms and other artwork present in both, which no colour rule survives. Contributes macro grouping only: boundary/coastline/relief precedence 0, because its added strokes would read as spurious province borders. The printed counts (Empire 22, Cathay 19, Lustria 21, ...) are carried in macro.PRINTED_COUNTS as a sanity check on the grouping, never as a target for our own state count.
